meta.name: second-brain
meta.description: Personal knowledge base powered by Ensue for capturing and retrieving understanding. Use when user wants to save knowledge, recall what they know, manage their toolbox, or build on past learnings. Triggers on "save this", "remember", "what do I know about", "add to toolbox", "my notes on", "store this concept".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随时保存和回顾你的个人知识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要记录和查找自己的知识笔记
copy.tagline_en: Save and recall your personal knowledge anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to record and retrieve your own knowledge notes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把知识保存到个人知识库，并在需要时检索出来。保存前会先询问你，确认后再存入。
howto.when: 当你说“保存这个”、“记住”、“关于X我知道什么”、“添加到工具箱”、“我的笔记”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 保存这个：Python 装饰器的工作原理
say.note: Claude 会起草条目并询问是否保存。

say.text: 关于 Docker 我知道什么
say.note: Claude 会搜索知识库并展示相关内容。

say.text: 把 Git 添加到工具箱
say.note: Claude 会创建工具箱条目。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you save knowledge to a personal knowledge base and retrieve it when needed. It always asks before saving.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "save this", "remember", "what do I know about", "add to toolbox", "my notes on", etc.

say_en.text: Save this: how Python decorators work
say_en.note: Claude drafts an entry and asks for confirmation.

say_en.text: What do I know about Docker
say_en.note: Claude searches the knowledge base and shows results.
